releases.description:
This patch incorporates the compatibility and type-safety feedback from the Obsidian Community Review without changing the kanban workflow.

## Popout-window reliability

- Replaced DOM and UI-event checks with Obsidian's cross-window-safe APIs throughout the board.
- Column controls, card menus, keyboard navigation, and drag targeting now behave consistently in popout windows.
- Animation-frame scheduling now uses the window-qualified browser API expected by Obsidian.

## Searchable settings

The global **Note hover previews** and **Date display** preferences now appear in Obsidian 1.13+ settings search.

The existing settings UI remains available on older supported Obsidian versions, so the minimum app version is unchanged at 1.10.2.

## Safer saved-state handling

Persisted column and card ordering is now normalized through explicit typed loops. Existing validation, deduplication, ordering, and saved board data are preserved; no migration is required.

## Developer checks

The project now runs the official Obsidian ESLint rules locally, making the community-review checks part of the normal lint command. Focused regression coverage was added for preview truncation and malformed saved ordering data.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/totocaster/kanban-base-view-obsidian/compare/0.7.0...0.7.1

releases.description:
This release makes Better Kanban Bases View faster to scan and easier to tune for the way each board works.

## Column controls

Every grouped column now has a subtle options menu beside its note count.

- Set a soft WIP limit for any column. When the limit is exceeded, the count changes to a compact current/limit display and the column gains a clear warning treatment.
- WIP limits remain advisory: card moves are never blocked.
- Add an optional semantic accent color to make workflow stages easier to recognize at a glance.
- Column settings are saved per Base grouping, so different boards can use different limits and colors.

## Dates at a glance

A new global Date display setting lets you choose exact or relative dates across every Kanban board.

- Relative dates retain the exact value in a tooltip.
- Workflow-oriented date properties such as due, deadline, and scheduled now highlight overdue, today, and tomorrow states.

## Faster card previews

Native Obsidian page previews now open when hovering anywhere on a card, with no modifier key required by default.

- Hover previews can be enabled or disabled globally in the plugin settings.
- The dedicated preview source makes the interaction faster and more reliable while still respecting Obsidian's Page preview configuration.

## Upgrade notes

No migration is required. Existing boards and saved card or column ordering continue to work as before. The new settings use Obsidian-native menus, icons, colors, and theme variables.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/totocaster/kanban-base-view-obsidian/compare/0.6.1...0.7.0

releases.description:
## Install

Once approved in the Obsidian community directory, install Better Kanban Bases View from Settings > Community plugins.

For manual installation, download the release assets and place manifest.json, main.js, and styles.css in .obsidian/plugins/bases-kanban-view-ttvl/.

## Highlights

- Adds a Kanban Bases view for grouped notes.
- Supports column and card reordering.
- Supports selected Bases properties, formula values, and optional card previews.
- Uses the plugin id bases-kanban-view-ttvl for community directory uniqueness.
